chunks: And ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.

Concerning a man who entered the prayer with the Imam while having been preceded by one rakʿah. So when the Imam finished, he left with the people, then remembered that one rakʿah had escaped him. He said: He repeats one rakʿah.

key_terms.بِرَكْعَةٍ: by one rakʿah; one unit of prayer that was missed
key_terms.فَاتَتْهُ: it escaped him; he had missed it
key_terms.وَاحِدَةً: one only, indicating a single rakʿah
key_terms.ٱلْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader in congregational salat

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he remembers after leaving congregational prayer that he missed one rakʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who joins congregational prayer after missing a rakʿah and then departs with the people when the Imam finishes. If he later remembers the missed rakʿah, he must perform one rakʿah to complete his prayer.
